series_start_reason: 2019Q1 is the first quarter with a product revenue line: Paratek's Q1 2019 10-Q prints 1,347 against a dash for 2018Q1, and the 10-Q states NUZYRA was launched in the U.S. in February 2019. The FY2019 10-K prints a dash for the whole of 2018.
series_end_reason: The last periodic filing is the Q2 2023 10-Q (0001628280-23-027035, filed 2023-08-03); the EDGAR submissions list shows no Q3 2023 10-Q or FY2023 10-K, and an 8-K filed 2023-09-21 (0001193125-23-239185, items 2.01, 3.01, 5.01) follows the completion of the company's acquisition.
notes: Quarterly NUZYRA net U.S. sales, USD thousands converted to millions. Q1-Q3 are read from the quarter's own 10-Q; Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 from the Q4 earnings releases (8-K Exhibit 99.1: 0001564590-20-006381 and 0001564590-21-008182); Q4 2021 and Q4 2022 are derived (derived_ytd_difference) as the 10-K year less the Q3 10-Q nine-month figure, because the earnings releases for those quarters are not among the company's EDGAR 8-K filings and no citable copy was found (Bigdata.com indexes the Q4 2022 release, which gives NUZYRA net U.S. sales of $66.4 million for Q4 2022 against $20.6 million for Q4 2021, equal to the derived 66.365 and 20.643). Full-year checks (thousands): 2019 1,347+1,702+3,053+5,415 = 11,517 against 11,517; 2020 7,303+8,133+10,895+12,422 = 38,753 against 38,753; 2021 sums to 106,085 against 106,084 (the six-month figure printed in the Q2 2021 10-Q, 66,009, is one thousand below the sum of its two quarters, rounding in the filing); 2022 19,918+25,082+25,455+66,365 = 136,820 against 136,820. Composition: the line includes BARDA procurements, so it is not purely commercial sales: the first 2,500-course procurement ($37.9 million) was delivered in June 2021 and is recognised in 2021Q2 (52,803), and the second 2,500-course procurement ($38.1 million per the Q4 2022 release) is in 2022Q4 (66,365); the FY2022 10-K says net product revenue includes 2,500 treatment courses sold to BARDA in each of 2022 and 2021. Excluding them, 2021 core commercial sales were 68.2 million and 2022 98.7 million (Q4 2022 release). SEYSARA is Almirall's product and reaches Paratek only as royalty and collaboration revenue (separate line). The Zai Lab collaboration for Greater China is a separate arrangement and is not separated here. Government contract service and grant revenue (BARDA) are separate lines and not in the series. The Q2 2023 10-Q is the last published quarter.
